title: Wdyt of this retro game toolkit to code games for your friends?
author: illumina_
selftext:
I've been building a retro game engine so I could vibe code games, and got a bit carried away with it. I ended up building a custom game engine + vibe coding harness and web editor. Because of the engine's constraints it's really easy and quick to get something up and running that is fun. 

I've been making games for my friend's birthday, with my son, and for other personal interests. It's fun to do on my phone from anywhere too. 

I was wondering if other people might enjoy using it so I thought I'd share it here with some invite codes.

[https://lantern.inc/signup](https://lantern.inc/signup?invite=raigd&utm_source=raidd). It's super early so I welcome all feedback!
